extracted text: The paper studies the effect of grain refinement on the fatigue life of 7075Al alloy. The 7075-FSP (Friction Stir Processed) samples showed improved high-cycle fatigue life compared to the parent 7075-T6 material. The FSP samples had a fine grain size in the range of 1-3 μm compared to an average grain size of 35 μm in the longitudinal rolling direction for 7075-T6 sheets.
property mapping:
Yield stress (MPa) -> YS [MPa]
UTS (MPa) -> UTS [MPa]
Elongation (%) -> elong [%]
abbreviations:
FSP - Friction Stir Processing, a technique used to refine the microstructure of the alloy
T6 - Solution heat treated and artificially aged
weight percentage: No specific elemental composition data is provided in the paper. 7075 is a standard aluminum alloy designation which would have a nominal composition according to Aluminum Association standards.
